## Pull Request Checklist

Please review and check all the following items before submitting your pull request:

### Code Quality
- [ ] The code builds successfully without errors
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] New tests have been added for new functionality
- [ ] Code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] Code has been properly formatted and linted
- [ ] Javadoc comments are included for public methods
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys or sensitive information

### Functionality
- [ ] The feature works as expected
- [ ] Edge cases have been considered and tested
- [ ] Performance impact has been evaluated
- [ ] Memory usage is reasonable
- [ ] Battery impact is minimal
- [ ] The feature is accessible and follows Material Design guidelines

### Documentation
- [ ] README.md has been updated if necessary
- [ ] Changelog.md has been updated
- [ ] Javadoc comments are accurate and complete
- [ ] Any new configuration options are documented

### Testing
- [ ] Manual testing has been performed
- [ ] Tests pass on multiple Android versions
- [ ] Tests pass on different screen sizes
- [ ] Error cases have been tested
- [ ] Network conditions have been tested
- [ ] Storage scenarios have been tested

### Security
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Proper permission handling
- [ ] Input validation is implemented
- [ ] No hardcoded sensitive data
- [ ] Proper error handling that doesn't expose sensitive information

### Performance
- [ ] No memory leaks
- [ ] UI is responsive
- [ ] Battery usage is optimized
- [ ] Network usage is efficient
- [ ] File operations are optimized
